title: midcontinent — peace

sentences.sentence: They  bowed before the emperor as he entered the court.
sentences.translation: 皇帝进入朝廷时他们都向他鞠躬致敬。

sentences.sentence: The daughter of an emperor does not worry about finding a husband.
sentences.translation: 皇帝女儿不愁嫁。

sentences.sentence: The old chancellor who had offended against the emperor was relegated to the distant boundaries of the country.
sentences.translation: 触犯了皇帝的老宰相被流放到遥远的边疆。

sentences.sentence: Agriculture is still the mainstay of the country’s economy.
sentences.translation: 农业仍然是这个国家经济的支柱。

phrases.translation: 全资子公司；全资附属机构；全资拥有子公司

sentences.sentence: They contract work out wholly.
sentences.translation: 他们把工作全部包了出去。

sentences.sentence: None of us can be absolved wholly of wrong doing.
sentences.translation: 我们当中没有一个人的罪行能完全获得赦免。

sentences.sentence: He reaffirmed that he was wholly responsible for the confusion.
sentences.translation: 他再次表明对此混乱情况他负有全部责任。

sentences.sentence: The stars glittered with the brilliance of jewels.
sentences.translation: 群星闪耀，犹如一颗颗璀璨的宝石。

phrases.translation: 俄克拉荷马市（美国俄克拉荷马州首府）

sentences.sentence: That leaves nothing for medical insurance for Baines or her husband, although the children get free cover from the state of Oklahoma. So she's at the free clinic to get blood tests.
sentences.translation: 虽然孩子们可以享受俄克拉荷马州的免费医保，但家里已没有余钱让贝恩丝或她的丈夫缴纳医疗保险，所以贝恩丝来到免费诊所做血压测试。

sentences.sentence: I really cannot imagine what my semester at the University of Oklahoma would have been like without him.
sentences.translation: 我简直无法想象，要是我在俄克拉何马大学的那个学期没有他会是什么样。

sentences.sentence: In this island is also found the rhinoceros, an animal less than the elephant, but larger than the buffalo.
sentences.translation: 在这个岛上还能找到犀牛，一种比大象小一点的动物，可是比水牛大。

sentences.sentence: Contrary to its name, the black rhinoceros is actually grey in color.
sentences.translation: 有别于它的名字，黑犀牛事实上是灰色的。

phrases.translation: 法定继承人；合法继承人

sentences.sentence: His successor died after only 15 months in office.
sentences.translation: 他的继任者就任仅15个月就去世了。

sentences.sentence: I’m sure she will be a worthy successor (= someone who is very good and deserves to be someone’s successor ) .
sentences.translation: 我确信她会是个当之无愧的接班人。

sentences.sentence: No-one enjoys paying tax.
sentences.translation: 没人喜欢缴税。

sentences.sentence: When his wife left him, Matt plumbed the very depths of despair.
sentences.translation: 妻子离他而去，马特陷入了绝望的深渊。

sentences.sentence: Gradually her anxiety lessened.
sentences.translation: 她的焦虑慢慢减轻了。

sentences.sentence: Grilled trout needs only a squeeze of lemon.
sentences.translation: 烤鳟鱼只需要一点柠檬榨汁。

sentences.sentence: a young park superintendent
sentences.translation: 年轻的公园负责人

sentences.sentence: the superintendent of the Methodist Church in Hawaii
sentences.translation: 夏威夷卫理公会负责人

phrases.translation: 保护生态环境的；对生态环境无害的
来自友军的误射炮火；误向自己人开火
对……友好；和某人友好相处
用户友好界面；用户方便型接口

sentences.sentence: a friendly smile
sentences.translation: 亲切的微笑

sentences.sentence: I’ve found a great pub – good beer and a friendly atmosphere.
sentences.translation: 我找到了一家很棒的酒馆——啤酒好，氛围也亲切。

sentences.sentence: a wasteful use of resources
sentences.translation: 滥用资源

sentences.sentence: Looking like a puffy white star studded with little pearls, this is the shell of an amoeboid protist called a foraminifera, or foram.
sentences.translation: 看看这个胀鼓鼓的白色星星，它上面满是珍珠。 这是一类变形虫（属于原生生物）的外壳，这类变形虫被称为有孔虫（ foraminifera or foram）。

sentences.sentence: Globs of mud pulled from the trench have yielded an assortment of bacteria, fungi and primitive single-celled organisms called foraminifera.
sentences.translation: 海沟中提取出的泥中生存着细菌、真菌和叫做有空虫类的原始单细胞有机体。

phrases.translation: 和平地；安静，宁静；安祥地
vi. 不扰乱治安；阻止别人扰乱治安；守法
内心的平静；内在和平；安心
与…言归于好；与…讲和；休战

sentences.sentence: The country is at peace with its neighbours for the first time in years.
sentences.translation: 这是多年来该国与其邻国第一次和平共处。

sentences.sentence: By the end of the century, France had made peace with Britain.
sentences.translation: 到那个世纪末，法国和英国议和了。

sentences.sentence: a city where people of different religions have lived together in peace for centuries
sentences.translation: 不同宗教的人们和平共处数百年的城市

sentences.sentence: efforts to bring peace to the region
sentences.translation: 为该地区争取和平的努力

sentences.sentence: a dangerous situation which threatens world peace
sentences.translation: 威胁世界和平的危险状况

sentences.sentence: An uneasy peace continued until 1939.
sentences.translation: 不稳定的和平局面维持到1939年。

sentences.sentence: the Northern Ireland peace talks
sentences.translation: 北爱尔兰和平会谈

sentences.sentence: an international peace conference
sentences.translation: 国际和平大会

sentences.sentence: the peace treaty that ended the First World War
sentences.translation: 终结第一次世界大战的和平条约

sentences.sentence: the Middle East peace process
sentences.translation: 中东和平进程

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 195 单元

midcontinent
n. 大陆中部

emperor
音标：英 /'emp(ə)rə/  美 /'ɛmpərɚ/
n. 皇帝, 君主
短语：emperor penguin — n. 皇企鹅
例句：They  bowed before the emperor as he entered the court.
皇帝进入朝廷时他们都向他鞠躬致敬。
例句：The daughter of an emperor does not worry about finding a husband.
皇帝女儿不愁嫁。
例句：The old chancellor who had offended against the emperor was relegated to the distant boundaries of the country.
触犯了皇帝的老宰相被流放到遥远的边疆。

mainstay
音标：英 /'meɪnsteɪ/  美 /'menste/
n. 支柱;骨干
例句：Agriculture is still the mainstay of the country’s economy.
农业仍然是这个国家经济的支柱。

connecticut
音标：英 /kə'netikət/  美 /kə'netikət/
n. (美国）康涅狄格

wholly
音标：英 /'həʊllɪ; 'həʊlɪ/  美 /'holli/
adv. 整个,全部
短语：wholly owned subsidiary — 全资子公司；全资附属机构；全资拥有子公司
例句：They contract work out wholly.
他们把工作全部包了出去。
例句：None of us can be absolved wholly of wrong doing.
我们当中没有一个人的罪行能完全获得赦免。
例句：He reaffirmed that he was wholly responsible for the confusion.
他再次表明对此混乱情况他负有全部责任。

brilliance
音标：英 /'brɪlj(ə)ns/  美 /'brɪljəns/
n. 光辉，辉煌
例句：The stars glittered with the brilliance of jewels.
群星闪耀，犹如一颗颗璀璨的宝石。

Oklahoma
音标：英 /,əuklə'həumə/  美 /,əuklə'həumə/
n. 俄克拉荷马州
短语：oklahoma city — 俄克拉荷马市（美国俄克拉荷马州首府）
短语：university of oklahoma — 奥克拉荷马大学
例句：That leaves nothing for medical insurance for Baines or her husband, although the children get free cover from the state of Oklahoma. So she's at the free clinic to get blood tests.
虽然孩子们可以享受俄克拉荷马州的免费医保，但家里已没有余钱让贝恩丝或她的丈夫缴纳医疗保险，所以贝恩丝来到免费诊所做血压测试。
例句：I really cannot imagine what my semester at the University of Oklahoma would have been like without him.
我简直无法想象，要是我在俄克拉何马大学的那个学期没有他会是什么样。

rhinoceros
音标：英 /raɪ'nɒs(ə)rəs/  美 /raɪ'nɑsərəs/
n. [动]犀牛
短语：rhinoceros horn — 犀牛角
例句：In this island is also found the rhinoceros, an animal less than the elephant, but larger than the buffalo.
在这个岛上还能找到犀牛，一种比大象小一点的动物，可是比水牛大。
例句：Contrary to its name, the black rhinoceros is actually grey in color.
有别于它的名字，黑犀牛事实上是灰色的。

externally
音标：英 /eks'tə:nəli/  美 /ɪk'stɝnli/
adv. 外部地, 外面地

successor
音标：英 /sək'sesə/  美 /sək'sɛsɚ/
n. 接班人, 继任人
短语：legal successor — 法定继承人；合法继承人
例句：His successor died after only 15 months in office.
他的继任者就任仅15个月就去世了。
例句：I’m sure she will be a worthy successor (= someone who is very good and deserves to be someone’s successor ) .
我确信她会是个当之无愧的接班人。

tax
音标：英 /tæks/  美 /tæks/
n. 税,税款
短语：income tax — 所得税
短语：tax system — 税制，课税制度
短语：tax revenue — 税收；赋税收入
短语：tax law — 税法
短语：tax rate — 税率
短语：tax policy — 税收政策
短语：personal income tax — 个人所得税
短语：business tax — 营业税
短语：individual income tax — [经]个人所得税
短语：property tax — 财产税；不动产税
短语：value-added tax — 增值税
短语：tax planning — 纳税计划
短语：tax collection — 征税；税捐稽征
短语：export tax — 出口税
短语：tax reform — 税制改革
短语：tax evasion — 漏税，逃税
短语：tax burden — 课税负担
短语：estate tax — （英）房地产遗产税
短语：local tax — 地方税
短语：tax rebate — 退税；税收回扣
例句：No-one enjoys paying tax.
没人喜欢缴税。

plumb
音标：英 /plʌm/  美 /plʌm/
v. （用铅垂）测量,探测
短语：plumb line — 铅垂线（等于plumb rule）
例句：When his wife left him, Matt plumbed the very depths of despair.
妻子离他而去，马特陷入了绝望的深渊。

lessen
音标：英 /'les(ə)n/  美 /'lɛsn/
v. 减少,缩小
例句：Gradually her anxiety lessened.
她的焦虑慢慢减轻了。

trout
音标：英 /traʊt/  美 /traʊt/
n. 鲑鱼
短语：rainbow trout — [鱼]虹鳟鱼
例句：Grilled trout needs only a squeeze of lemon.
烤鳟鱼只需要一点柠檬榨汁。

permian
音标：英 /'pə:miən/
n&a. [地]二叠纪(的)
短语：permian period — 二叠纪
短语：middle permian — 中二迭世

superintendent
音标：英 /suːp(ə)rɪn'tend(ə)nt; sjuː-/  美 /,supərɪn'tɛndənt/
n. 主管人，监管人
例句：a young park superintendent
年轻的公园负责人
例句：the superintendent of the Methodist Church in Hawaii
夏威夷卫理公会负责人

friendly
音标：英 /'fren(d)lɪ/  美 /'frɛndli/
adj. 友好的, 友谊的
短语：environmentally friendly — 保护生态环境的；对生态环境无害的
短语：environmental friendly — 环保的
短语：environment friendly — 环保的；对环境有利的
短语：user friendly — [电]使用者亲和性
短语：friendly exchanges — 友好往来
短语：friendly society — （英）互助会；互济会
短语：friendly fire — 来自友军的误射炮火；误向自己人开火
短语：friendly match — 友谊赛
短语：be friendly with — 对……友好；和某人友好相处
短语：friendly software — 友好软件
短语：user friendly interface — 用户友好界面；用户方便型接口
例句：a friendly smile
亲切的微笑
例句：I’ve found a great pub – good beer and a friendly atmosphere.
我找到了一家很棒的酒馆——啤酒好，氛围也亲切。

wasteful
音标：英 /'weɪstfʊl; -f(ə)l/  美 /'westfl/
adj. 浪费的，挥霍的
例句：a wasteful use of resources
滥用资源

foraminifera
n. 有孔虫类
例句：Looking like a puffy white star studded with little pearls, this is the shell of an amoeboid protist called a foraminifera, or foram.
看看这个胀鼓鼓的白色星星，它上面满是珍珠。 这是一类变形虫（属于原生生物）的外壳，这类变形虫被称为有孔虫（ foraminifera or foram）。
例句：Globs of mud pulled from the trench have yielded an assortment of bacteria, fungi and primitive single-celled organisms called foraminifera.
海沟中提取出的泥中生存着细菌、真菌和叫做有空虫类的原始单细胞有机体。

peace
音标：英 /piːs/  美 /pis/
n. 和平, 安静
短语：in peace — 和平地；安静，宁静；安祥地
短语：peace of mind — 内心的宁静；明镜止水
短语：world peace — 世界和平
短语：at peace — 处于和平状态
短语：nobel peace prize — 诺贝尔和平奖
短语：peace process — 和平进程
短语：peace talks — 和谈
短语：live in peace — 和平相处
短语：keep the peace — vi. 不扰乱治安；阻止别人扰乱治安；守法
短语：make peace — 讲和；调解；言和和解
短语：peace and quiet — 安静；宁静
短语：peace treaty — 和平条约
短语：inner peace — 内心的平静；内在和平；安心
短语：love peace — 热爱和平
短语：war and peace — 战争与和平
短语：rest in peace — 安息
短语：at peace with — 与…和睦相处
短语：disturb the peace — 扰乱治安
短语：make peace with — 与…言归于好；与…讲和；休战
短语：make peace with someone — 和解；言归于好
例句：The country is at peace with its neighbours for the first time in years.
这是多年来该国与其邻国第一次和平共处。
例句：By the end of the century, France had made peace with Britain.
到那个世纪末，法国和英国议和了。
例句：a city where people of different religions have lived together in peace for centuries
不同宗教的人们和平共处数百年的城市
例句：efforts to bring peace to the region
为该地区争取和平的努力
例句：a dangerous situation which threatens world peace
威胁世界和平的危险状况
例句：An uneasy peace continued until 1939.
不稳定的和平局面维持到1939年。
例句：the Northern Ireland peace talks
北爱尔兰和平会谈
例句：an international peace conference
国际和平大会
例句：the peace treaty that ended the First World War
终结第一次世界大战的和平条约
例句：the Middle East peace process
中东和平进程
